title: World of Warcraft: Forever Raid Overview—Locations, Raid Sizes, and Attunement
author: Blizzard Entertainment

short_news.title_en: World of Warcraft: Forever Raid Overview—Locations, Raid Sizes, and Attunement

changes.text: The Barrow Deeps
Location:Within Mount Hyjal, with multiple entrances connected through Mount Hyjal, Winterspring, and Blackmaw Hold
Level: 60
Raid Size: 10 players
Hyjal Summit
Location: Summit of Mount Hyjal near the World Tree Nordrassil
Level: 60
Raid Size: 20 players
Onyxia’s Lair
Location: Dustwallow Marsh
Level: 60
Raid Size: 40 players

Hidden beneath Kalimdor, the Barrow Deeps is a maximum-level raid for 10 players. The prison once held Illidan Stormrage for 10,000 years, but its dark passages have been opened. Now, players will descend into the fabled prison to learn what became of those left behind—and how the wardens plan to contain the danger below.
Entrances connected to Mount Hyjal, Winterspring, and Blackmaw Hold give raiders multiple paths into Barrow Deeps. Inside, 10-player groups will face eight bosses as they explore the prison’s depths.

path: Climb to the Peak of Hyjal Summit
changes.text: At the peak of Mount Hyjal near the World Tree Nordrassil, Hyjal Summit features 13 bosses and begins with a battle against an ancient guardian. From there, raid groups can choose from multiple paths across the mountain, exploring ruins above and below ground as they confront the forces threatening Hyjal and open the way to the final encounters.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: Deep in Dustwallow Marsh, Onyxia’s Lair is a level 60 raid for 40 players. Onyxia, a dragon of the Black Dragonflight and the younger sister of Nefarian, guards her brood here while working to manipulate Azeroth’s mortal races.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: Onyxia’s three-phase encounter turns up the heat with powerful fire attacks that can punish an unprepared raid. Players should build their fire resistance before entering, then be ready to reposition and work together as the battle shifts around them. Designed for level 60 players, Onyxia’s Lair requires each member of the raid to carry the Drakefire Amulet to enter.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: Before heading to Onyxia’s Lair, each player will need to earn the Drakefire Amulet through a faction-specific attunement questline. Start early, bring a few friends for the elite quests, and leave plenty of time for several trips into high-level dungeons.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: Beginning in the Burning Steppes, you’ll pick up the quest “Dragonkin Menace” from Helendis Riverhorn.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: Helendis will then send you on the first of a series of six quests all named “The True Masters” to investigate the Black Dragonflight’s influence on the Blackrock orc clan.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: Follow the chain to Marshal Maxwell at Morgan’s Vigil in the Burning Steppes, who will send you into Blackrock Depths to recover Marshal Windsor—or proof of his demise—in “Marshal Windsor.”

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: Find the item A Crumpled Up Note off of enemies in the Blackrock Depths dungeon, which starts the quest “A Crumpled Up Note.” Bring the note to Marshal Windsor in his cell in Blackrock Depths.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: In “A Shred of Hope” retrieve Windsor’s lost information from Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge in Blackrock Depths.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: Help Windsor escape Blackrock Depths in “Jail Break!” And return to Marshal Maxwell at Morgan’s Vigil in the Burning Steppes.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon will send you on “The Dragon’s Eye” to hunt across Azeroth for someone capable of helping you.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: They will send you through Upper Blackrock Spire in “Drakefire Amulet” take the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath and receive the Drakefire Amulet.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: In the Badlands, you’ll begin your journey with the quest “Blood and Thunder” from Warlord Goretooth in Kargath.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: This leads directly to the quest “Warlord’s Command”, which will take you throughout Lower Blackrock Spire.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: Goretooth will then send you to report to Eitrigg in Orgrimmar, then to seek council with Thrall.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: In “For the Horde!” Journey back into Lower Blackrock Spire to claim the head of Warchief Rend Blackhand for Thrall.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: Listen to Thrall’s discoveries during “What the Wind Carries”, then seek Rexxar wandering the roads of Desolace for “The Champion of the Horde.”

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: Rexxar will direct you to deliver his testament to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands during “The Testament of Rexxar.”

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: Use your Amulet of Draconic Subversion in “Emberstrife” to seek out the ancient drake Emberstrife in Dustwallow Marsh.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: Emberstrife will test your skills in four quests each beginning with “The Test of Skulls,” bringing him the skulls of the named dragons he sends you to face. All in all, you’ll face Scryer, Somnus, Chronalis, and Axtroz.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: Emberstrife will give you the Dull Drakefire Amulet in “Ascension...” Bring it back to Rexxar roaming in Desolace.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: Rexxar sends you to Upper Blackrock Spire in “Blood of the Black Dragon Champion” to take the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath.

path: Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair
changes.text: Before you enter: Make sure the Drakefire Amulet is in your inventory. It does not need to be equipped to enter Onyxia’s Lair.

Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit, and Onyxia’s Lair unlock on December 9, giving players time after launch to reach level 60 and prepare their groups. Whether you plan to explore Mount Hyjal with 10 or 20 players or face Onyxia with a full group of 40, choose the raid that fits your group and start getting ready. With all raids currently planned to reset each week, you can settle into a consistent schedule and return with your group for another run.
